title: Roohe Shariyat hai ye gham jaane ibadat hai matam
body:
Roohe Shariyat Hai Yeh Gham.
Jaane Ibadat Hai Matam.
1. Hai Yahi Eema’N Hum Sabka.
Aik Hai Qura’N Aik Quda.
Padhte Hai Hum Jiska Kalma.
Uske Nawase Ka Hai Gham.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Majlis E Sarwar Jannat Hai.
Sabse Badi Yeh Nemat Hai.
Dil Meim Aik Hi Hasrat Hai.
Farshe Aza Par Nikle Dam.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hai Mafhoom Mawaddat Ka.
Hai Yeh Qulasa Sunnat Ka.
Hai Yeh Taqaza Fitrat Ka.
Dil Mein Basalo Sheh Ka Gham.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sabse Juda Hai Inka Muqaam.
Ashke Aza Hai Inka Naam.
Jhuk Ke Inhein Karte Hai Salaam.
Chashma E Kousar Aur Zam Zam.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haq Pe Jiyo Aur Haq Pe Maro.
Zalim Ke Aage Na Jhuko.
Matam Sheh Ka Karte Raho.
Jab Tak Hai Seene Mein Dam.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Qasim Ibne Shabbar Asws., Ke.
Hum Hai Azadar Akbar Asws., Ke.
Matami Hum Hai Asghar Asws., Ke.
Hum Pe Hai Yeh Zehra Sa., Ka Karam.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Pehne Hue Ehraam E Aza.
Qafila Anjuman Asghari Ka.
Pohonchega Ek Din Karbobala.
Karta Hua Qooni Matam.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kehta Hun Ehle Eemaa’N Se.
Laakh Nisha’N Ho Sajdo’N Ke.
Laazim Hai Jannat Ke Liye.
Seene Pe Ho Daaghe Matam.
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Saqi E Kousar Ka Kunba.
Teen Dino Tak Tha Pyasa.
Shaane Kataye Labe Darya.
Qatl Hua Saqqa E Haram.
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Kehte Raho Yawar Yeh Baat.
Thakte Nahi Matam Ke Haath.
Sardi Ho Garmi Ya Baraaat.
Thak Jaata Hai Har Mausam.
Az: Shayer E Ahlebait Janab Yawar Ali Yawar Sahab.
